units.source_text: 阿雪珍惜《修身教科书》的外壳，

en.t: Ayuki cherished the cover of the Self-Cultivation Textbook,

units.source_text: 像雏鸡爱惜它屁股上的蛋壳，

en.t: the way a chick clings to the eggshell stuck to its rear,

units.source_text: 又像脱下的蛇蜕非常讨厌地贴在她身上的某个部位。

en.t: and also as if a shed snakeskin were clinging unpleasantly to some part of her body.
